description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens across different categories of text. The horizontal axis represents “Categories” with labels including “Administrative”, “Religion”, “Non-fiction”, “Fiction”, “Law”, “News”, and “Blogs”, listed in that order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled “Tokens (K)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10584, with tick marks at 2000-unit intervals. There are seven light blue bars, each corresponding to a category. The “Administrative” bar has a height of approximately 6472 tokens, while the “Religion” bar reaches a height of 1889 tokens. The “Non-fiction” bar is approximately 387 tokens in height, and the “Fiction” bar is 652 tokens. The “Law” bar reaches 354 tokens, the “News” bar is 1626 tokens, and the “Blogs” bar is 32 tokens. The bars are not visually emphasized and are arranged in the order of the category labels as presented on the horizontal axis.
